title: Side setback, walls 3.6 m to 7 m high (R30-R60)
text: C3.4.1 Buildings are set back from lot boundaries in accordance with Table 3.4a. Refer Figure 3.4a, b, c. Table 3.4a Lot boundary setbacks, side setback: Wall height 3.6m to 7m 1.5m.

verified.note: 1.5m confirmed (Table 4A p7 agrees). Table 3.4a (p32) prints the bands as 'Wall height up to 3.5m', 'Wall height 3.6m to 7m' and 'Wall height above 7.1m', leaving 3.5-3.6 m and 7.0-7.1 m undefined; Table 4A (p7) prints '3.6m -7m (2nd storey)' and '7.1m and above (3rd storey)'. The encoded band conditions (> 3.5, > 7.0) are an inference.

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.1#side-3.6-to-7m-r30-r40 and C3.4.1#side-3.6-to-7m-r50, merged into one R30-R60 record (same Table 3.4a value 1.5 m, no pedestrian access way reduction above R25; Chapter 4 Part 1 has no R80+ or R100-SL codes). Applies only where the building has walls 3.6 m to 7 m high (condition on building.has_walls_3_6_to_7m); the band does not depend on the building's maximum wall height. Rounding gap between wall-height bands unresolved.
